sections: 3.9.1 Direct Element Constructors: copied-node type/name/nilled/typed-value properties

defaultPolicy: Preserve for compiled constructors: retains the established fresh-element xs:anyType behavior and repairs the observed partial deep-copy annotation loss. Explicit strip produces untyped elements and untypedAtomic attributes. Provider hooks invoked outside compiled constructors retain their existing null/legacy policy unless a construction mode is supplied.
contract: Immutable declaring-module modes on constructor IR, including inline functions and imported declarations
Preserve complete copied node schema types/declarations, nilled, ID/IDREFS and typed list/QName values; strip resets metadata per REC, retaining is-id only for xml:id
Preserve/no-preserve namespace-sensitive element values raise XQTY0086; copied namespace-sensitive free attributes raise XQTY0086 under preserve
Destination-private metadata copying never mutates source nodes
No construction routing, dependency, baseline, schema backend, REQ-139/ADR-006 or release change
intentionalScope: Existing core XDocument/IXmlSchemaInfo seam; no XSD 1.1 backend or callback adoption
Nullable additive provider inputs preserve legacy direct-hook calls outside compiled constructors; compiled default is explicitly preserve
